description: This script contains functions for managing firmware upgrades on a Linksys device, including determining the target firmware partition, performing the upgrade, and copying configuration backups.

methods.name: linksys_get_target_firmware
methods.description: Determines and returns the target firmware partition label ('kernel1' or 'kernel2') based on the current boot partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process based on the specified firmware image, including setting environment variables and handling different magic numbers.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_linksys
methods.description: Copies the backup configuration file to the system configuration directory.
